text: The English major is a comprehensive discipline that focuses on the study of English language, literature, and culture, while also considering cross-cultural communication and practical applications. It not only cultivates solid language skills, but also emphasizes in-depth understanding of the society, history, and thoughts of English-speaking countries. It serves as a bridge connecting Chinese and Western cultures and is an indispensable fundamental discipline in the era of globalization. From Shakespeare's plays to contemporary Hollywood movies, from classical literature to online popular language, the study of the English major covers both the "form" of language and the "spirit" of culture, combining practicality with humanism.
